I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function.
The meeting is on Thursday at 15:00 for 30 minutes.
The email body should be professional and contain all the necessary information.
I will craft a clear and concise email body.

- `day`: "Thu"
- `start`: "15:00"
- `body`: A suitable confirmation message.

I will write a simple confirmation email stating the date, time, and attendees of the meeting.
Example body:
"This email confirms the 30-minute partners' meeting has been scheduled for Thursday, November 19, at 15:00 Eastern.
Attendees: Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor."

This seems correct. I will now call the function.
After sending the email, the task will be complete.
I will then end my session.
